interface.longDescription: One self-contained plugin for Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon or Intel. Codex starts the matching bundled runtime and native MIDI component automatically, without a separate runtime installation or helper service. Review the exact stock V15 package or validated custom FWSC and explicitly confirm each SysEx update. Preserve durable recovery evidence after an uncertain transfer. Common-firmware self-updates, USB serial and UBOOT writes remain unavailable. Physical update acceptance is pending.
